name: WiAR
summary: Public cross-environment WiFi activity and gesture dataset with sixteen actions performed by ten volunteers in three indoor environments.

settings.scenario: Two collection studies vary distance (1/3/6 m) and receiver height (60/90/120); ten volunteers were collected, while public factor folders are A/B/C

standardization.notes: Decode every authentic Intel 5300 record and preserve raw complex CSI. The source [T,Tx=1,Rx=3,S=30] becomes canonical [T,S=30,Tx=1,Rx=3]. Keep all native subcarriers and links; use the official nominal 30 Hz rate to build complete 100 Hz, 3 s activity windows without dropping the remainder.
